写作前置 · 文中表达

这里是所选阅读材料中适合本题的表达；例句按本题语境编写。

The World of Sugar｜工业化、消费与作者立场
attempts to reduce consumption

降低消费量的努力

在健康话题里要补清consumption指什么，例如含糖饮料，而不是笼统主张减少所有食品消费。适合描述措施与商业激励之间的关系。

本题例句 · 编写示范

Attempts to reduce consumption of sugary drinks among children are more likely to succeed when healthier alternatives are affordable and easy to obtain.

儿童肥胖题要求提出措施；这句话把减少含糖饮料摄入与可负担替代品联系起来，强调环境支持而非只责怪个人自控。

a large number of processed foods

大量加工食品

可讨论配方、标签或食品环境，但加工食品并非全部有相同营养特征，例句应限定要比较的成分。

本题例句 · 编写示范

When added sugar is present in a large number of processed foods, clear labels can help parents compare products more easily.

适合儿童肥胖措施段中的食品信息环境；条件句聚焦添加糖与标签，避免把所有加工食品概括为有害。

回到这份材料的精读

A rise in childhood obesity is a real threat to health with an increasing number of children now classified as overweight. What are the causes of the problem and what measures can be taken to solve them?

本次写作任务

写两个主体段，约180–220词：解释饮食环境与活动机会两个原因，再分别匹配学校/社区措施。这里练考试论证，不作个人医疗建议，也不写没有来源的研究数字。

What are the causes of the problem and what measures can be taken to solve them?本次写作任务写两个主体段，约180–220词：解释饮食环境与活动机会两个原因，再分别匹配学校/社区措施。这里练考试论证，不作个人医疗建议，也不写没有来源的研究数字。我的段落0 词保留作答，查看答案先作答；不确定的题也可记录判断与疑点。对照答案，回到证据参考写法下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。One contributing factor is that energy-dense convenience foods can be easier to obtain than balanced meals in children’s daily surroundings. Busy households may rely on ready-made options, and frequent promotion of snacks can make these products particularly appealing. At the same time, some children have limited opportunities to be physically active. Long periods spent sitting at school or using screens may be combined with a lack of safe places to play nearby. These circumstances can reinforce one another: an environment that encourages frequent snacking while making activity inconvenient creates persistent difficulties for healthy routines.Responses should make healthier routines easier to maintain, rather than rely only on telling children to show more self-control. Schools can provide balanced meals and practical food education, while clear information for families can help them compare everyday choices. The lack of activity opportunities also needs a direct response. Safe routes to school, accessible play areas and regular opportunities for movement during the school day can reduce barriers to being active. Parents, schools and local authorities each influence part of this environment, so coordinated changes are more likely to be useful than an isolated awareness campaign that leaves the underlying conditions unchanged.原因1食品获取/营销环境→学校均衡供餐和实用信息；原因2活动机会不足→安全路线、场地、在校活动。不用“kids are lazy”作为单一原因；解释环境如何影响日常选择，避免道德评判。参考段落是任务论证示范，未用虚构数字、未经核验研究或诊疗建议增加权威感。答后精读篇章结构饮食与活动环境两个原因，最后交代相互强化。按同样次序匹配措施，并解释为何宣传单独不够。词语与搭配contributing factor：因素之一，避免假装唯一原因。reduce barriers to being active：措施如何起效。underlying conditions：回指便利食品与活动机会环境。句子精读These circumstances can reinforce one another ... → 指代上文两类环境而非增加新原因。... rather than rely only on telling children ... → 论证措施应改变条件，不只发口号。我的修订／证据笔记
